name: agent
description: Delegate a sub-task to another role in the Guild. The child role runs to completion and returns its ResultCard. An optional budget tightens the child's tool-call or token limits.

role.description: Name of the role to invoke, as declared in the Guild.

task.description: The task text to hand to the child role.

budget.description: Optional per-role budget override for the child.

maxToolCalls.description: Maximum tool calls the child role may make.

maxTokens.description: Maximum total tokens the child role may consume.
